Только из плакатов, размещенных на судне.
CD0604 — Eye protection.answer: СУБ компании.

CD0604 — Eye protection.question: Why is it important to wear sunglasses when working in a very sunny environment?
options: UV radiation is a known cause of eye disease.
It removes the need to apply sun tan lotion to the face.
It is a chance to show colleagues your new sunglasses.
It is not important, as sunlight has no negative effects on the eyes.
CD0604 — Eye protection.answer: UV radiation is a known cause of eye disease.

CD0604 — Eye protection.question: 在阳光充足的环境中作业时，为什么一定要佩戴太阳镜？
options: 紫外线是眼部疾病的一个已知原因。
不必在面部擦防晒霜了。
可以向同事展示您的新太阳镜。
不重要，因为阳光对眼睛没有负面影响。
CD0604 — Eye protection.answer: 紫外线是眼部疾病的一个已知原因。

CD0604 — Eye protection.question: Почему важно использовать солнцезащитные очки при работе в условиях с ярким солнечным светом?
options: УФ-излучение — известная причина возникновения болезней глаз.
Это избавляет от необходимости наносить солнцезащитный крем на лицо.
Это шанс продемонстрировать новые очки своим коллегам.
Это не важно, так как солнечный свет не оказывает негативного воздействия на глаза.
CD0604 — Eye protection.answer: УФ-излучение — известная причина возникновения болезней глаз.

CD0604 — Eye protection.question: Why must eye protection be worn when operating a drill?
options: Fine metal particles may get thrown into the air.
The drill might slip and go into your eye socket.
To prevent getting arc flash damage.
Simply to improve your eyesight for the task.
CD0604 — Eye protection.answer: Fine metal particles may get thrown into the air.

CD0604 — Eye protection.question: 为什么进行钻孔作业时必须佩戴护目装置？
options: 细金属颗粒可能进入空气中。
钻头可能滑出，进入眼眶内。
防止电弧光损伤。
只是改善任务视线。
CD0604 — Eye protection.answer: 细金属颗粒可能进入空气中。

CD0604 — Eye protection.question: Зачем нужно использовать средства защиты органов зрения при работе на сверлильном станке?
options: Мелкие частицы металла могут подниматься в воздух.
Сверло может соскользнуть и попасть в глаз.
Чтобы предотвратить травмирование вспышкой дугового разряда.
Чтобы просто улучшить видимость на рабочем месте.
CD0604 — Eye protection.answer: Мелкие частицы металла могут подниматься в воздух.

CD0604 — Eye protection.question: Which option BEST completes the following sentence? As with all PPE, those items used for eye protection should… .
options: be maintained in a clean, serviceable condition at all times.
only be cleaned before use.
only be cleaned after use.
be cleaned and serviced once a month so that it doesn’t need to be checked in between.
CD0604 — Eye protection.answer: be maintained in a clean, serviceable condition at all times.

CD0604 — Eye protection.question: 下面哪个选项最好地完成了以下说法： 与所有 PPE 一样，这些用来眼镜保护的物品应该…
options: 随时保持干净、可使用的状态。
仅在使用之前清洁。
仅在使用之后清洁。
每月清洁和保养一次，中间无需检查。
CD0604 — Eye protection.answer: 随时保持干净、可使用的状态。

CD0604 — Eye protection.question: Какой вариант ответа НАИЛУЧШИМ ОБРАЗОМ дополняет следующее предложение? Как и любые СИЗ, средства защиты органов зрения необходимо…
options: ...всегда содержать в чистоте и исправном техническом состоянии.
...очищать только перед использованием.
...очищать только после использования.
...очищать и обслуживать раз в месяц, чтобы их не нужно было проверять в другое время.
CD0604 — Eye protection.answer: ...всегда содержать в чистоте и исправном техническом состоянии.

CD0604 — Eye protection.question: What is the LIKELY result of having persistent dust, sand or grit in the eye?
options: Scratched surface of the cornea.
Perforated pupil.
Sand embedded in the iris.
There will be no damage done.
CD0604 — Eye protection.answer: Scratched surface of the cornea.

CD0604 — Eye protection.question: 如果眼中存在永久性的尘埃、沙子或砂砾，可能造成的后果如何？
options: 眼角膜表面摩擦。
瞳孔穿透。
虹膜中嵌入沙子。
不会有任何损伤。
CD0604 — Eye protection.answer: 眼角膜表面摩擦。

CD0604 — Eye protection.question: Что из перечисленного ниже МОЖЕТ появиться при наличии в глазу трудноудалимых пылинок, песчинок или соринок?
options: Царапины на поверхности роговицы.
Прокол зрачка.
Проникновение песчинок в радужную оболочку.
Это не приведет к травме.
CD0604 — Eye protection.answer: Царапины на поверхности роговицы.

CD0604 — Eye protection.question: Which of the options BEST completes the following sentence? Any item of equipment found to be damaged or in poor condition… .
options: must be taken out of service and a replacement obtained before you continue working.
should be returned to its place before you choose equipment in better condition.
should be used one last time before it is taken out of service.
must be fixed as best you can before you perform a critical task.
CD0604 — Eye protection.answer: must be taken out of service and a replacement obtained before you continue working.

CD0604 — Eye protection.question: 下面哪个选项最好地完成了以下说法： 护目装置的任何物品损坏或情况较差时…
options: 必须弃用并获取替换装置，然后再继续作业。
应将其放回原位并选择状况更好的装置。
应在弃用之前最后用一次。
必须在执行重要任务之前尽可能进行修复。
CD0604 — Eye protection.answer: 必须弃用并获取替换装置，然后再继续作业。

CD0604 — Eye protection.question: Какой вариант ответа НАИЛУЧШИМ ОБРАЗОМ дополняет следующее предложение? Если средства защиты повреждены или находятся в неудовлетворительном состоянии...
options: ...их необходимо вывести из эксплуатации и заменить перед продолжением работы.
...их нужно вернуть на место, прежде чем выбрать средство защиты в лучшем состоянии.
...их следует использовать последний раз перед выводом из эксплуатации.
...их необходимо по возможности отремонтировать перед выполнением критически важного задания.
CD0604 — Eye protection.answer: ...их необходимо вывести из эксплуатации и заменить перед продолжением работы.

CD0604 — Eye protection.question: Which option BEST completes the following sentence? Sharp, intense, bright light will… .
options: be extremely damaging to the eye, particularly if experienced over any length of time.
only be damaging to the eye if the person has poor eyesight.
not damage the eye.
cause temporary but not permanent damage to the eye.
CD0604 — Eye protection.answer: be extremely damaging to the eye, particularly if experienced over any length of time.

CD0604 — Eye protection.question: 下面哪个选项最好地完成了以下说法： 尖锐、强烈的明亮光线会… .
options: 对眼睛造成极大的伤害，特别长时间接触的时候更是如此。
只有人们视线较差时才会对眼睛造成损伤。
不会损伤眼睛。
对眼睛造成临时伤害，不会造成永久性伤害。
CD0604 — Eye protection.answer: 对眼睛造成极大的伤害，特别长时间接触的时候更是如此。

CD0604 — Eye protection.question: Какой вариант ответа НАИЛУЧШИМ ОБРАЗОМ дополняет следующее предложение? Яркий и интенсивный свет…
options: ...очень опасен для глаз, особенно при продолжительном воздействии.
...может травмировать только человека с плохим зрением.
...не травмирует глаза.
...может вызвать временную, но не постоянную травму глаз.
CD0604 — Eye protection.answer: ...очень опасен для глаз, особенно при продолжительном воздействии.

CD0604 — Eye protection.question: Which of the following statements is true about crewmembers who normally wear spectacles to see?
options: Certain types of goggles are designed to be worn over ordinary spectacles.
In most cases, ordinary spectacles will offer sufficient protection.
They will have to take their glasses off in order to wear the correct protective equipment.
They should not be asked to complete any task that could potentially damage their eyes.
CD0604 — Eye protection.answer: Certain types of goggles are designed to be worn over ordinary spectacles.

CD0604 — Eye protection.question: 对于佩戴普通眼镜的船员，以下哪个说法是正确的？
options: 某些类型的护目镜可以在佩戴在普通眼镜上面。
大多数情况下，普通眼镜将提供充分的保护。
必须取下自己的眼镜才能佩戴正确的护目装置。
不应该让他们来完成可能损伤其眼镜的任务。
CD0604 — Eye protection.answer: 某些类型的护目镜可以在佩戴在普通眼镜上面。

CD0604 — Eye protection.question: Какое из приведенных утверждений верно в отношении членов экипажа, использующих обычные очки в повседневной жизни?
options: Некоторые типы закрытых защитных очков можно носить поверх обычных очков.
В большинстве случаев обычные очки обеспечивают достаточную защиту.
Они должны будут снять очки, чтобы использовать надлежащие средства защиты органов зрения.
Им не следует поручать задания, при выполнении которых они могут травмировать глаза.
CD0604 — Eye protection.answer: Некоторые типы закрытых защитных очков можно носить поверх обычных очков.

CD0604 — Eye protection.question: What is the potential risk of wearing protective eye glasses? Select the BEST answer.
options: They do not provide a seal, which means dust can still get into the eyes.
They may carry infection from other users.
They will fracture if struck by anything.
There are no potential risks, protective eye glasses will protect you from all risks
CD0604 — Eye protection.answer: They do not provide a seal, which means dust can still get into the eyes.

CD0604 — Eye protection.question: 佩戴护目镜的潜在风险是什么？ 请选择最佳答案。
options: 无法提供任何形式的密封，也就是说，尘粒仍然会进入眼睛中。
可能携带其他用户的病毒。
被任何东西卡住的话会破碎。
没有潜在风险，护目镜会针对所有风险提供保护
CD0604 — Eye protection.answer: 无法提供任何形式的密封，也就是说，尘粒仍然会进入眼睛中。

CD0604 — Eye protection.question: Какой риск существует при ношении защитных очков? Выберите НАИБОЛЕЕ ПОДХОДЯЩИЙ вариант ответа.
options: Они не оснащены уплотнением, а значит пыль все равно может попасть в глаза.
Они могут переносить инфекцию от других пользователей.
Они могут расколоться в случае удара.
Потенциальных рисков нет, защитные очки защищают от всех видов рисков.
CD0604 — Eye protection.answer: Они не оснащены уплотнением, а значит пыль все равно может попасть в глаза.

CD0604 — Eye protection.question: Which of the following is NOT a recommended way of removing dust, sand or grit found in the eye?
options: Rub eye.
Flush it out with water.
Dislodge it by blinking.
Dislodge it by gently pulling the upper eyelid downwards.
CD0604 — Eye protection.answer: Rub eye.

CD0604 — Eye protection.question: 下面哪个不是去除眼中尘埃、沙子或砂砾的推荐方式？
options: 揉眼睛。
用水冲洗。
眨眼去除。
轻轻将上眼睑向下拉将其去除。
CD0604 — Eye protection.answer: 揉眼睛。

CD0604 — Eye protection.question: Что из перечисленного ниже НЕ рекомендуется для удаления пылинок, песчинок или соринок из глаза?
options: Тереть глаз.
Удалить, промыв глаз водой.
Сместить морганием.
Сместить, аккуратно оттянув верхнее веко вниз.
CD0604 — Eye protection.answer: Тереть глаз.

CD0604 — Eye protection.question: What should be done with new protective eye equipment?
options: It should be stored in an orderly fashion, with an inventory maintained to ensure there is always an adequate supply.
It should be mixed in with the existing eye equipment to save on wear and tear.
It should replace all existing eye protection, which should be removed from the vessel regardless of its condition.
It should be distributed evenly amongst the crew so that each individual is responsible for their own equipment.
CD0604 — Eye protection.answer: It should be stored in an orderly fashion, with an inventory maintained to ensure there is always an adequate supply.

CD0604 — Eye protection.question: 对于新的护目装置应该怎么做？
options: 应该整齐保存，并保持库存，保证充足供应。
应与现有护目装置混合保存，以延缓磨损。
应该替换所有现有的护目装置，无论其状况如何都从船舶中去除。
应该在船员中均匀发放，以便每个人都能对自己的装置负责。
CD0604 — Eye protection.answer: 应该整齐保存，并保持库存，保证充足供应。

CD0604 — Eye protection.question: Как необходимо поступать с новыми средствами защиты органов зрения?
options: Хранить надлежащим образом и поддерживать запас, чтобы они всегда были в наличии.
Использовать вперемешку с имеющимися средствами защиты органов зрения, чтобы сэкономить на износе.
Заменить ими все имеющиеся средства защиты органов зрения, которые необходимо убрать с судна независимо от состояния.
Равномерно распределить между всеми членами экипажа, чтобы каждый нес ответственность за свои средства защиты.
CD0604 — Eye protection.answer: Хранить надлежащим образом и поддерживать запас, чтобы они всегда были в наличии.

CD0604 — Eye protection.question: Where can you find additional information on the PPE required for handling a particular chemical?
options: Safety Data Sheet.
Material Hazard Sheet.
Safe Handling Sheet.
SMS.
CD0604 — Eye protection.answer: Safety Data Sheet.

CD0604 — Eye protection.question: 在何处可以找到处理某种特定化学品所需 PPE 的附加信息？
options: 安全数据表。
材料危险表。
安全处理表。
SMS。
CD0604 — Eye protection.answer: 安全数据表。

CD0604 — Eye protection.question: Где можно найти дополнительную информацию о СИЗ, необходимых для работы с определенными химическими веществами?
options: Паспорт безопасности.
Лист опасности материала.
Лист по безопасному обращению.
СУБ.
CD0604 — Eye protection.answer: Паспорт безопасности.

CD0604 — Eye protection.question: Where should protective eye equipment be stored?
options: In a clean, dust-free environment.
In each crewmembers’ cabin.
In the engine room workshop.
In the deck workshop.
CD0604 — Eye protection.answer: In a clean, dust-free environment.

CD0604 — Eye protection.question: 护目装置应保存在什么位置？
options: 干净无尘环境中。
每个船员的舱室内。
机房车间内。
甲板车间内。
CD0604 — Eye protection.answer: 干净无尘环境中。

CD0604 — Eye protection.question: Где необходимо хранить средства защиты органов зрения?
options: В чистом месте, защищенном от воздействия пыли.
В каждой каюте у членов экипажа.
В мастерской машинного отделения.
В мастерской на палубе.
CD0604 — Eye protection.answer: В чистом месте, защищенном от воздействия пыли.

CD0604 — Eye protection.question: What is the course of action to take in the event of getting a corrosive liquid in your eye?
options: Immediate and extensive flushing to minimise damage.
Gently pull the upper eyelid downwards.
Apply a bandage directly to the eye.
Do not do anything until it is seen by the medical officer.
CD0604 — Eye protection.answer: Immediate and extensive flushing to minimise damage.

CD0604 — Eye protection.question: 眼中进入腐蚀性液体时，要采取哪些措施？
options: 立即使用大量清水进行冲洗以最大程度降低损伤。
轻轻将上眼睑向下拉。
将绷带直接敷盖在眼睛上。
看医生，之前不作任何操作。
CD0604 — Eye protection.answer: 立即使用大量清水进行冲洗以最大程度降低损伤。

CD0604 — Eye protection.question: Что нужно сделать при попадании в глаза агрессивной жидкости?
options: Немедленное и обильное промывание, чтобы минимизировать последствия.
Аккуратно оттянуть верхнее веко вниз.
Наложить повязку непосредственно на глаз.
Ничего не делать до осмотра медицинским работником.
CD0604 — Eye protection.answer: Немедленное и обильное промывание, чтобы минимизировать последствия.

CD0605 — Workplace Ergonomics and Back C.question: Which of these strategies might you try to relieve fatigue if you have to stand in one place for a period of time?
options: Periodically walk around.
Lie down every half hour to relax your neck.
Eat a nutritious snack.
Lean against a bulkhead.
CD0605 — Workplace Ergonomics and Back C.answer: Periodically walk around.

CD0605 — Workplace Ergonomics and Back C.question: Which of the following is not indicative of a good work area?
options: You can work long periods standing if you lean over your desk.
Comfortable temperature.
Work materials you use are within easy reach.
Lighting is directly on your work area.
CD0605 — Workplace Ergonomics and Back C.answer: You can work long periods standing if you lean over your desk.

CD0605 — Workplace Ergonomics and Back C.question: To support your spine when you are sitting:
options: Sit straight with your back supported.
Sit on a stool.
Get up and move around every few hours.
Adjust your screen so it is above eye level, if you are in front of a computer.
CD0605 — Workplace Ergonomics and Back C.answer: Sit straight with your back supported.

CD0605 — Workplace Ergonomics and Back C.question: Which of these is a good lifting technique?
options: Planning the lift before you get started.
Using your back.
Lifting quickly.
Stretching to lift objects to high places.
CD0605 — Workplace Ergonomics and Back C.answer: Planning the lift before you get started.

CD0605 — Workplace Ergonomics and Back C.question: You are doing a routine job with a repetitive motion and your hand begins to hurt. What do you do?
options: Stop working and re-evaluate your risk factors with your supervisor.
Continue working – it’s good to just get the job done.
Stop work and leave it for someone else.
Change hands.
CD0605 — Workplace Ergonomics and Back C.answer: Stop working and re-evaluate your risk factors with your supervisor.

CD0605 — Workplace Ergonomics and Back C.question: Falls and slips are examples of ___________, which can cause severe back pain.
options: Impact traumas
Repetitive traumas
Sudden traumas
Intense traumas
CD0605 — Workplace Ergonomics and Back C.answer: Impact traumas

CD0605 — Workplace Ergonomics and Back C.question: What causes repetitive trauma injuries?
options: Repeating an unhealthy position, movement, or lifting technique.
Lifting a heavy, awkward load without assistance.
Tripping or falling.
Wearing incorrect footwear.
CD0605 — Workplace Ergonomics and Back C.answer: Repeating an unhealthy position, movement, or lifting technique.

CD0605 — Workplace Ergonomics and Back C.question: Which of these statements about exercise and back health is incorrect?
options: Exercise should be avoided whenever you experience back pain.
Exercise builds strong and flexible muscles.
Exercise should be done regularly for it to be the most beneficial.
Exercise along with proper diet is important for good health.
CD0605 — Workplace Ergonomics and Back C.answer: Exercise should be avoided whenever you experience back pain.

CD0605 — Workplace Ergonomics and Back C.question: How can you avoid straining your back while carrying a load?
options: Use a hand truck or dolly.
Walk quickly, taking large steps.
Carry the load on your shoulder.
Gently twist your back when changing directions.
CD0605 — Workplace Ergonomics and Back C.answer: Use a hand truck or dolly.

CD0605 — Workplace Ergonomics and Back C.question: While enlisting a helper to lift a load, it’s a good idea to:
options: Keep the load at the same level as you move smoothly to carry the load.
Find a person who is taller than you.
Keep your knees straight and your back bent, and lift the load together.
Lower the load at the same time, keeping your knees straight.
CD0605 — Workplace Ergonomics and Back C.answer: Keep the load at the same level as you move smoothly to carry the load.

CD0605 — Workplace Ergonomics and Back C.question: How does diet impact back health?
options: Poor food choices can cause weight gain and being overweight puts extra strain on your back.
A poor diet builds flexible back muscles.
A good diet causes back muscles to tighten and knot.
Poor food choices help to minimize the pain of back strain and injury.
CD0605 — Workplace Ergonomics and Back C.answer: Poor food choices can cause weight gain and being overweight puts extra strain on your back.

CD0605 — Workplace Ergonomics and Back C.question: Building strong and flexible muscles through exercise helps prevent back pain and injury.
options: True
False
CD0605 — Workplace Ergonomics and Back C.answer: True

CD0605 — Workplace Ergonomics and Back C.question: ___________ can cause your muscles to lose their strength and ability to function.
options: Aging and disease
Poor posture
Improper lifting
Exercise and a healthy diet
CD0605 — Workplace Ergonomics and Back C.answer: Aging and disease

CD0605 — Workplace Ergonomics and Back C.question: ___________ can cause the back muscles to tighten and knot, which can lead to muscle spasms and back pain.
options: Tension and stress
Lack of exercise
Aging
Poor posture
CD0605 — Workplace Ergonomics and Back C.answer: Tension and stress

CD0605 — Workplace Ergonomics and Back C.question: How does eating healthily help to keep your back healthy?
options: A healthy diet helps you keep your weight down, which reduces the stress on your back.
A poor diet provides you with more energy for safer lifting.
A poor diet builds more muscle.
A low caloric diet improves bone mass, making the spine stronger.
CD0605 — Workplace Ergonomics and Back C.answer: A healthy diet helps you keep your weight down, which reduces the stress on your back.

CD0605 — Workplace Ergonomics and Back C.question: If a doctor prescribes pain medication to relieve your back pain, you should:
options: Advise your supervisor that you are on prescribed pain medication.
Increase your prescribed dosage if your pain increases.
Return to your job without notifying supervisor.
Operate machinery.
CD0605 — Workplace Ergonomics and Back C.answer: Advise your supervisor that you are on prescribed pain medication.

CD0605 — Workplace Ergonomics and Back C.question: Which of these is NOT a risk factor associated with ergonomic injury?
options: Proper posture
Inadequate work environment
Exposure time
Repetition
CD0605 — Workplace Ergonomics and Back C.answer: Proper posture

CD0630 — Boiler furnace explosions.question: Why might the move to low Sulphur fuels increase the risk of boiler furnace explosions?
options: Because some low sulphur fuels are more prone to waxing in cold conditions
Because some low sulphur fuels are more difficult to ignite
Because some low sulphur fuels have a lower flashpoint
Because some low sulphur fuels have a higher flashpoint
CD0630 — Boiler furnace explosions.answer: Because some low sulphur fuels are more prone to waxing in cold conditions

CD0630 — Boiler furnace explosions.question: How are boilers protected from low fuel pressure causing poor atomisation and poor combustion? Select the ONE best answer.
options: There is a low pressure trip for the boiler fuel supply
The boiler flame detector will detect poor combustion
Steam or air atomisation will counteract the effects of low oil pressure
Fuel oil filters are fitted with a high differential pressure alarm
CD0630 — Boiler furnace explosions.answer: There is a low pressure trip for the boiler fuel supply

CD0630 — Boiler furnace explosions.question: What safety feature is fitted to an auxiliary boiler to prevent leakage of fuel oil into the boiler when it is not firing? Select the ONE best answer.
options: Double shut off valves are fitted on the fuel supply to the burner
The fuel oil pump is stopped when the boiler is not firing
A drain is fitted to the combustion air supply trunking
The fuel oil supply valve is of the ‘fail closed’ type
CD0630 — Boiler furnace explosions.answer: Double shut off valves are fitted on the fuel supply to the burner

CD0630 — Boiler furnace explosions.question: According to this module, what should happen to the air damper(s) during the boiler purging sequence?
options: They should open fully during the purge sequence
They should remain in the ‘just open’ position during the purge sequence
They should remain fully closed during the purge sequence
They should remain fixed in the ‘low firing’ position throughout the purge sequence
CD0630 — Boiler furnace explosions.answer: They should open fully during the purge sequence

CD0630 — Boiler furnace explosions.question: What should happen if there is a flame failure on a boiler?
options: There should be an alarm and lock-out, requiring a manual reset
There should be an alarm, followed by one automatic attempt to re-light
There should be an alarm, followed by no more than two automatic attempts to re-light
There should be an alarm only and then the boiler should automatically re-light if in automatic mode
CD0630 — Boiler furnace explosions.answer: There should be an alarm and lock-out, requiring a manual reset

CD0630 — Boiler furnace explosions.question: If there is a high back pressure in the furnace what should be done?
options: The heat exchange surfaces should be cleaned
The air flow to the boiler should be reduced
The firing rate should be reduced
Nothing, this can be expected with older boilers
CD0630 — Boiler furnace explosions.answer: The heat exchange surfaces should be cleaned

CD0630 — Boiler furnace explosions.question: What is the consequence of reducing the boiler furnace purge time?
options: There is an increased risk of a boiler furnace explosion
The boiler may fail to light due to lack of air
The process of fault diagnosis can be speeded up
The boiler will be much more responsive to sudden load demands
CD0630 — Boiler furnace explosions.answer: There is an increased risk of a boiler furnace explosion

CD0630 — Boiler furnace explosions.question: What should happen if the boiler combustion air fan is damaged or not running? Select the ONE best answer.
options: There should be a low combustion air trip
The boiler flame detector will detect poor combustion
The burner will go out and a flame failure alarm and trip will occur
The fuel supply should reduce to achieve good combustion
CD0630 — Boiler furnace explosions.answer: There should be a low combustion air trip

CD0630 — Boiler furnace explosions.question: According to this module, how can wax deposits from distillate fuels be avoided?
options: By keeping the fuels at a temperature above their cloud point and at least ten degrees above their pour point
By keeping the fuels at a temperature below their cloud point and at least ten degrees below their pour point
By not heating distillate fuels, since these are low viscosity fuels that do not require it
By regularly draining settling and service tanks
CD0630 — Boiler furnace explosions.answer: By keeping the fuels at a temperature above their cloud point and at least ten degrees above their pour point

CD0630 — Boiler furnace explosions.question: According to this module, what volume of air is necessary to purge a boiler furnace properly?
options: Five to seven times the volume of air in the furnace
Two to three times the volume of air in the furnace
A volume equal to the volume of air in the furnace
None, provided the boiler is in good working order
CD0630 — Boiler furnace explosions.answer: Five to seven times the volume of air in the furnace

CD0630 — Boiler furnace explosions.question: If there have been several flame failures whilst trying to fire a boiler, what should be done?
options: The cause should be properly investigated
We should put the controls to manual and keep trying
We should keep the controls in automatic, but keep trying
Provided that the igniter is working, we should keep trying
CD0630 — Boiler furnace explosions.answer: The cause should be properly investigated

CD0670 — Separators, S-type maintenence.question: Which parts should be changed during separator maintenance?
options: All of those specified by the manufacturer.
Only those that look damaged or worn.
Only the O-rings.
Only the O-rings and nylon sealing rings.
CD0670 — Separators, S-type maintenence.answer: All of those specified by the manufacturer.

CD0670 — Separators, S-type maintenence.question: How is the bowl locking ring aligned?
options: A pin on the locking ring locates in a hole in the bowl bottom.
The split in the ring fits over a locating pin in the bowl bottom.
The locking ring and bowl bottom have clear markings which must be aligned.
The locking ring is free to rotate around in its groove, so no alignment is necessary.
CD0670 — Separators, S-type maintenence.answer: A pin on the locking ring locates in a hole in the bowl bottom.

CD0670 — Separators, S-type maintenence.question: When starting a separator, what should we see for the load at the ammeter?
options: There will be an initial high load whilst the separator runs up to speed, then the load should reduce to normal.
The load should be the normal load for that separator at all times.
There will be an initial low load whilst the separator runs up to speed, then the load should increase to normal.
The load will change from high to low several times over a period of a few minutes before returning to normal load.
CD0670 — Separators, S-type maintenence.answer: There will be an initial high load whilst the separator runs up to speed, then the load should reduce to normal.

CD0670 — Separators, S-type maintenence.question: How should the O-rings in the separator be lubricated during re-assembly?
options: Using the silicone grease provided in the spares kit.
Using a light coating of lubricating oil.
Liquid soap should be applied to make re-assembly easier.
They are self-lubricating, so nothing else should be applied to them.
CD0670 — Separators, S-type maintenence.answer: Using the silicone grease provided in the spares kit.

CD0670 — Separators, S-type maintenence.question: Why must any type of damage to separator parts be avoided? Select the ONE most important reason.
options: Because the parts rotate at high speed, and very large out of balance forces that could cause injury or damage  will be created.
Because it makes it harder to assemble the parts.
Because it may prevent sealing rings from forming a tight seal.
Because it will cause wear on other parts when the separator is re-assembled and put back into operation.
CD0670 — Separators, S-type maintenence.answer: Because the parts rotate at high speed, and very large out of balance forces that could cause injury or damage  will be created.

CD0670 — Separators, S-type maintenence.question: When should the spring and arm for the paring tube be removed?
options: Before lifting the bowl hood.
After lifting the bowl hood.
After the paring tube assembly has been removed.
It does not need to be removed during normal maintenance.

CD0670 — Separators, S-type maintenence.question: When should the bearings for the paring tube be replaced?
options: At the recommended service intervals or if there is excessive play.
Only if there is excessive lateral play.
Since these parts do not rotate at high speed, there is no need to replace them unless they are very badly worn.
As a precaution, they should be replaced every time the separator is opened up for maintenance.
CD0670 — Separators, S-type maintenence.answer: At the recommended service intervals or if there is excessive play.

CD0670 — Separators, S-type maintenence.question: How do you check that you have the correct spares to carry out separator maintenance? Select the ONE best answer.
options: Check the requirements in the manual against the actual contents of the spares pack.
Check that the serial number on the spares pack matches the separator type.
Check that there is an unopened spares pack in the ship’s spare gear store.
Check that the correct spares pack is listed in the spare gear inventory.
CD0670 — Separators, S-type maintenence.answer: Check the requirements in the manual against the actual contents of the spares pack.

CD0670 — Separators, S-type maintenence.question: If a bowl disc is found to be damaged in any way, what should be done?
options: It should be replaced with the correct spare.
Provided it is just one disc, It can be left out of the re-assembly.
Since there are many discs in the stack, it can be used again if the damage does not cover more than 5% of the disc surface.
Damaged discs can usually be repaired by brazing or similar methods.
CD0670 — Separators, S-type maintenence.answer: It should be replaced with the correct spare.

CD0670 — Separators, S-type maintenence.question: When attempting to lift off the top disc, you cannot get the eyebolts to seat properly on the top disc. What should you do?
options: Clean and lubricate the threads until the eyebolts can be seated correctly.
Use tools to lever and prise the top disc off.
Since the top disc isn’t that heavy, this is not important as long as the eyebolts are in by a few turns.
Use gentle heat and a few blows with a mallet until the top disc can be lifted by hand.
CD0670 — Separators, S-type maintenence.answer: Clean and lubricate the threads until the eyebolts can be seated correctly.

CD0670 — Separators, S-type maintenence.question: Which valves need to be closed before working on a separator?
options: All oil and water valves for the separator, and its sludge outlet valve.
Only the fuel oil valves, since there is no pressure in any other system once the separator has stopped.
Only the operating and sealing water valves, since there is no pressure in any other system once the separator has stopped and power has been turned off.
None, since all solenoid valves will be closed once the power to the separator has been switched off.
CD0670 — Separators, S-type maintenence.answer: All oil and water valves for the separator, and its sludge outlet valve.

CD0670 — Separators, S-type maintenence.question: What parts of the separator are most at risk from erosion and galling?
options: The sliding bowl parts.
The bowl discs.
The paring tube.
The paring disc.

CD0670 — Separators, S-type maintenence.question: After cleaning the disc stack, how would you identify the top disc?
options: It has no spacing ridges on the top surface.
It should be stamped with a number 1.
It has no spacing ridges on the bottom surface.
All the discs are the same, so it doesn’t matter.
CD0670 — Separators, S-type maintenence.answer: It has no spacing ridges on the top surface.

CD0670 — Separators, S-type maintenence.question: How can we avoid damaging separator parts when removing O-rings?
options: Only use extraction tools made of soft material such as copper.
Use a small screwdriver, very carefully.
Use a steel knife, modified and bent as necessary to suit the job.
Use small steel wedges to get behind the O-rings.
CD0670 — Separators, S-type maintenence.answer: Only use extraction tools made of soft material such as copper.

CD0670 — Separators, S-type maintenence.question: During dis-assembly, you notice that the bowl compression screws seem to be going in at a slight upwards angle. What should you do?
options: Continue tightening them with moderate force, they are meant to go in at this angle.
Gently hit them with a hammer so that they are at right angles to the bowl.
Clean out the threads in the bowl using a metric tap.
Stop using the bolts and use several parallel pin punches instead.
CD0670 — Separators, S-type maintenence.answer: Continue tightening them with moderate force, they are meant to go in at this angle.

CD0671 — Separators, P-type maintenence.question: Before starting work on a separator, where should it be identified and isolated?
options: Both locally and at the main switchboard.
Only at the main switchboard.
Only locally.
Either locally or at the main switchboard.
CD0671 — Separators, P-type maintenence.answer: Both locally and at the main switchboard.

CD0671 — Separators, P-type maintenence.question: Some parts of the separator may need to be prised apart. To avoid damage, how should this be done?
options: Using tools made from soft material such as copper.
Using screwdrivers with a wide blade.
Using steel wedges.
Using the edge of a packing knife.
CD0671 — Separators, P-type maintenence.answer: Using tools made from soft material such as copper.

CD0671 — Separators, P-type maintenence.question: After cleaning the disc stack, how would you identify the top bowl disc?
options: It has no spacing ridges on the top surface.
It should be stamped with a number 1.
It has no spacing ridges on the bottom surface.
All the discs are the same, so it doesn’t matter.
CD0671 — Separators, P-type maintenence.answer: It has no spacing ridges on the top surface.

CD0671 — Separators, P-type maintenence.question: Which valves need to be closed before working on a separator?
options: All oil and water valves for the separator, and its sludge outlet valve.
Only the fuel oil valves, since there is no pressure in any other system once the separator has stopped.
Only the operating and sealing water valves, since there is no pressure in any other system once the separator has stopped and power has been turned off.
None, since all solenoid valves will be closed once the power to the separator has been switched off.
CD0671 — Separators, P-type maintenence.answer: All oil and water valves for the separator, and its sludge outlet valve.

CD0671 — Separators, P-type maintenence.question: As a final check, how do we know that the top disc has been replaced in the correct position?
options: It has a drill marking that should be in line with the locating pin for the bowl hood.
It has a drill marking that should be 180 degrees from the locating pin for the bowl hood.
It is impossible to put the top disc back in the wrong position.
The top disc and disc stack are a balanced unit, so their position in the bowl does not matter.
CD0671 — Separators, P-type maintenence.answer: It has a drill marking that should be in line with the locating pin for the bowl hood.

CD0671 — Separators, P-type maintenence.question: On re-assembly, how should the sliding surfaces be lubricated?
options: With Molykote, and in accordance with the instructions in the manual.
With Silicone grease, and in accordance with the instructions in the manual.
With light lubricating oil, and in accordance with the instructions in the manual.
They should be left unlubricated but highly polished.
CD0671 — Separators, P-type maintenence.answer: With Molykote, and in accordance with the instructions in the manual.

CD0671 — Separators, P-type maintenence.question: During dismantling, how should the bowl compression tool be positioned when fitted to the bowl?
options: So that we can see the bowl locating pin, and so that none of the clamps are covering the holes for the lock ring compression screws.
So that one of the clamps is in line with the bowl locating pin.
It should be screwed fully down, as far as possible, on the bowl hood.
So that the clamps on the tool are in line with the holes for the lock ring compression screws.
CD0671 — Separators, P-type maintenence.answer: So that we can see the bowl locating pin, and so that none of the clamps are covering the holes for the lock ring compression screws.

CD0671 — Separators, P-type maintenence.question: During dismantling, you notice that the bowl compression screws seem to be going in at a slight upwards angle. What should you do?
options: Continue tightening them with moderate force, they are meant to go in at this angle.
Gently hit them with a hammer so that they are at right angles to the bowl.
Clean out the threads in the bowl using a metric tap.
Stop using the bolts and use several parallel pin punches instead.
CD0671 — Separators, P-type maintenence.answer: Continue tightening them with moderate force, they are meant to go in at this angle.

CD0671 — Separators, P-type maintenence.question: Apart from size, what is the main difference between the Alfa Laval S-type and P-type separators?
options: The S-type uses the ALCAP principle, whilst the P-type uses a gravity disc.
The P-type uses the ALCAP principle, whilst the S-type uses a gravity disc.
The S-type cannot be used for lubricating oils.
The P-type can only be used as a clarifier.
CD0671 — Separators, P-type maintenence.answer: The S-type uses the ALCAP principle, whilst the P-type uses a gravity disc.

CD0671 — Separators, P-type maintenence.question: Which ONE of the following parts does NOT rotate?
options: The paring disc.
The top disc.
The level ring.
The gravity disc.

CD0671 — Separators, P-type maintenence.question: The level ring on the top of the disc stack often sticks in place due to oil deposits. What is the best way to remove it?
options: By using soft tools and levering it up from the top of the distributor.
By using soft tools and levering it up from the top of the discs.
By hitting it upwards with a soft mallet.
By warming it gently with a small flame.
CD0671 — Separators, P-type maintenence.answer: By using soft tools and levering it up from the top of the distributor.

CD0671 — Separators, P-type maintenence.question: How do we know that the distributor and disk stack has been replaced in the correct position?
options: The groove on the distributor should be in line with the locating pin for the bowl hood.
The groove on the distributor should be 180 degrees from the locating pin for the bowl hood.
It is impossible to put the distributor back in the wrong position.
The distributor and disc stack are a balanced unit, so their position in the bowl does not matter.
CD0671 — Separators, P-type maintenence.answer: The groove on the distributor should be in line with the locating pin for the bowl hood.

CD0671 — Separators, P-type maintenence.question: During dismantling, when should the lock ring compression screws be removed?
options: Immediately after the bowl lock ring has been removed.
They should be left in place until the bowl lock ring is re-fitted.
Immediately after the bowl compression tool has been finally removed.
It is not important when they are removed.
CD0671 — Separators, P-type maintenence.answer: Immediately after the bowl lock ring has been removed.

CD0671 — Separators, P-type maintenence.question: What parts of the separator are most at risk from erosion and galling?
options: The sliding bowl parts.
The bowl discs.
The gravity disc.
The level ring.

CD0671 — Separators, P-type maintenence.question: On re-assembly, once the bowl compression tool has been correctly tightened, what should be used to help the bowl lock ring be snapped into position?
options: A soft tool made from copper or similar.
A screwdriver.
Fingers, to avoid damaging the bowl parts.
Gentle blows with a hammer.
CD0671 — Separators, P-type maintenence.answer: A soft tool made from copper or similar.

CD0672 — Separators, S-type and P-type m.question: What do we need to remember about the bottom bearing?
options: It is not symmetrical, so we need to check which way round it is fitted.
It is a high quality roller bearing and can be re-used many times.
It should be checked for excessive free play before re-fitting it.
Because it is self-aligning, some free play can be expected.
CD0672 — Separators, S-type and P-type m.answer: It is not symmetrical, so we need to check which way round it is fitted.

CD0672 — Separators, S-type and P-type m.question: How should the spindle taper be prepared just before refitting the bowl?
options: It should be clean and dry.
It should be lightly oiled.
It should be coated with Molykote.
It should be coated with silicone grease.
CD0672 — Separators, S-type and P-type m.answer: It should be clean and dry.

CD0672 — Separators, S-type and P-type m.question: How is the operating slide located on the bowl bottom?
options: By a locating pin.
By witness marks.
By lining up the securing bolts in any suitable position.
The securing bolts will only line up correctly if it is in the correct position.

CD0672 — Separators, S-type and P-type m.question: After refitting, how can the correct alignment of the shaft be checked?
options: Before refitting the bowl, use a clock gauge secured on the frame and running on the shaft.
By putting the shaft in a lathe and using a clock gauge.
As long as the shaft is turning freely by hand, the alignment will be satisfactory.
The alignment cannot be properly checked once the shaft is refitted.
CD0672 — Separators, S-type and P-type m.answer: Before refitting the bowl, use a clock gauge secured on the frame and running on the shaft.

CD0672 — Separators, S-type and P-type m.question: Why is the alignment of the air guard important when re-installing the shaft?
options: The cut-outs need to be in the correct place to accommodate the belt drive and the speed sensor.
It will jam when lowered if not properly aligned.
The bolt holes will not be aligned if it is not in the correct position.
Unless correctly aligned, the air guard will contact the bottom of the separator and prevent the shaft being fully lowered into position.
CD0672 — Separators, S-type and P-type m.answer: The cut-outs need to be in the correct place to accommodate the belt drive and the speed sensor.

CD0672 — Separators, S-type and P-type m.question: How should the operating slide and its guide pins be lubricated during re-assembly?
options: Using the Molykote specified in the manual.
Using a light coating of lubricating oil.
Liquid soap should be applied to make re-assembly easier.
They are highly polished, so nothing else should be applied to them.
CD0672 — Separators, S-type and P-type m.answer: Using the Molykote specified in the manual.

CD0672 — Separators, S-type and P-type m.question: When should the operating slide plugs and nozzle be replaced?
options: At every overhaul.
Every 12,000 hours.
If visibly damaged.
They should be cleaned and dressed up if in reasonable condition.

CD0672 — Separators, S-type and P-type m.question: How should the O-rings in the separator be lubricated during re-assembly?
options: Using the silicone grease provided in the spares kit.
Using a light coating of lubricating oil.
Liquid soap should be applied to make re-assembly easier.
They are self-lubricating, so nothing else should be applied to them.
CD0672 — Separators, S-type and P-type m.answer: Using the silicone grease provided in the spares kit.

CD0672 — Separators, S-type and P-type m.question: Where are the drain holes for the operating water?
options: Around the periphery of the bowl bottom, underneath the discharge slide.
Near the centre of the bowl bottom, underneath the discharge slide.
The operating water is drained through the sludge ports, around the outside of the bowl bottom.
The operating water is drained back through the solenoid valves.
CD0672 — Separators, S-type and P-type m.answer: Around the periphery of the bowl bottom, underneath the discharge slide.

CD0672 — Separators, S-type and P-type m.question: If the shaft tapered or bearing surfaces are excessively pitted or worn, what should be done?
options: The shaft should be replaced.
The shaft should be dressed using a fine stone.
The shaft should be dressed using emery cloth.
The shaft should be lightly re-machined.

CD0672 — Separators, S-type and P-type m.question: What methods are used to fit the separator bearings?
options: Some are heated and some are a push fit, the manual should be consulted.
They are all pre-heated in an oil bath.
They are all a push fit using a special tool.
They are all a push fit, but can be tapped on with a soft mallet.
CD0672 — Separators, S-type and P-type m.answer: Some are heated and some are a push fit, the manual should be consulted.

CD0672 — Separators, S-type and P-type m.question: Why should the neck bearing cover be checked carefully for cracks?
options: Because it may indicate contact with the shaft due to other problems.
Because it is a light casting prone to cracking.
Because of the material used, it is prone to fatigue.
Because it tends to crack if previously over-tightened.
CD0672 — Separators, S-type and P-type m.answer: Because it may indicate contact with the shaft due to other problems.

CD0672 — Separators, S-type and P-type m.question: Under what circumstances do the tightening torques given the manual apply?
options: For threads which have been lubricated in accordance with the instructions in the manual.
For clean, dry threads.
Since they are torque settings, they apply under any circumstances.
Tightening torques are not required, provided the right size spanner is used with normal manual effort.
CD0672 — Separators, S-type and P-type m.answer: For threads which have been lubricated in accordance with the instructions in the manual.

CD0672 — Separators, S-type and P-type m.question: During dis-assembly, the bottom bearing holder seems to be very difficult to remove. What should you do?
options: Check that all of the retaining screws have been removed.
Apply more force with a tommy bar.
Apply some release oil and try again with more force.
Just leave it in place.
CD0672 — Separators, S-type and P-type m.answer: Check that all of the retaining screws have been removed.

CD0672 — Separators, S-type and P-type m.question: Why do we need to remove the drive belt before removing the separator shaft?
options: To release the tension from the bottom end of the shaft.
We don’t, it will just fall away when we lift the shaft out.
Because it sits inside a stepped recess in the shaft.
Because the bottom end of the shaft is larger than the part of the shaft where the belt is fitted.
CD0672 — Separators, S-type and P-type m.answer: To release the tension from the bottom end of the shaft.

CD0672 — Separators, S-type and P-type m.question: After the bowl bottom has been removed, when should the outside surfaces of the operating slide be cleaned?
options: Before disassembly, to prevent sticking.
After disassembly, so that they can be soaked in a cleaning agent.
The outside surfaces are not important, so it makes no difference.
After disassembly, so that they can be wire brushed.

CD0673 — Back to basics, Engine room rou.question: How can you check that air is being properly supplied to an aerobic type sewage plant?
options: By sighting the flowmeter for the air supply and any clear plastic pipes fitted to air lifts etc.
By checking that the compressor is in the automatic position
By checking that the air compressor is running
By checking that the plant is under a small positive pressure and that the level is normal
CD0673 — Back to basics, Engine room rou.answer: By sighting the flowmeter for the air supply and any clear plastic pipes fitted to air lifts etc.

CD0673 — Back to basics, Engine room rou.question: When might some continuous white smoke coming from the funnel be expected?
options: When slow steaming
At full speed
When carrying out soot-blowing
When in port
CD0673 — Back to basics, Engine room rou.answer: When slow steaming

CD0673 — Back to basics, Engine room rou.question: What should you do if you see steam coming from the funnel?
options: Report and investigate it: It could be caused by a lifting or leaking safety valve
Nothing, this is quite normal when engine room tanks are being heated
Lower the boiler firing rate or adjust the economizer damper position to reduce steam generation
Open up the fuel oil tank heating steam to make use of the excess steam production
CD0673 — Back to basics, Engine room rou.answer: Report and investigate it: It could be caused by a lifting or leaking safety valve

CD0673 — Back to basics, Engine room rou.question: What effect might a prolonged period of running at low load have on a refrigeration compressor?
options: Oil may be carried over, leading to a low oil level in the sump
The compressor may overheat
There will be icing on the suction pipe of the compressor
The compressor will trip out due to low pressure on the suction side
CD0673 — Back to basics, Engine room rou.answer: Oil may be carried over, leading to a low oil level in the sump

CD0673 — Back to basics, Engine room rou.question: What is the best way to ensure that automatic, self-cleaning, filters are working? Select the ONE best answer.
options: Check the pressure differential indication, perform a manual backflush, and check the backflush counter
Check that the differential pressure is okay
Check that they are free of alarms
Check the outlet pressure
CD0673 — Back to basics, Engine room rou.answer: Check the pressure differential indication, perform a manual backflush, and check the backflush counter

CD0673 — Back to basics, Engine room rou.question: If the differential pressure on a manual oil filter is high, what should be done?
options: It should be changed over and cleaned
Nothing, provided that the outlet pressure is still satisfactory
Some dirty oil should be drained from the base of the filter
It should be noted in the engine room log book, so that it can be cleaned later
CD0673 — Back to basics, Engine room rou.answer: It should be changed over and cleaned

CD0673 — Back to basics, Engine room rou.question: To avoid corrosion, it is important that air receivers are kept drained of water. What is the best way to check the automatic drain valves are working?
options: By operating their manual bypass, and confirming that the receiver is free of water
By waiting next to them until you hear them operate
By placing a hand on them, and waiting until you detect them operating
By opening them up and inspecting them at weekly intervals
CD0673 — Back to basics, Engine room rou.answer: By operating their manual bypass, and confirming that the receiver is free of water

CD0673 — Back to basics, Engine room rou.question: What does a higher than normal pressure drop across the gas side of an economizer indicate?
options: Fouling of the gas side
A rise in atmospheric pressure
Poor heat transfer across the gas side of the economizer
Poor heat transfer across the water side of the economizer
CD0673 — Back to basics, Engine room rou.answer: Fouling of the gas side

CD0673 — Back to basics, Engine room rou.question: What materials can be burned in a ship’s incinerator?
options: Only selected and approved materials
Any type of shipboard domestic wastes
Any type of waste, provided that it fits through the incinerator loading door
Sludge, waste oils, and anything else collected as rubbish onboard
CD0673 — Back to basics, Engine room rou.answer: Only selected and approved materials

CD0673 — Back to basics, Engine room rou.question: Apart from avoiding a high level, why is it important to check the tank level of a vacuum sewage collection system?
options: Because a minimum level of fluid is needed to operate the ejector which creates the vacuum
Because the tank must be emptied before entering coastal waters
Because the tank must be emptied before entering a MARPOL special area for sewage waters
Because the vacuum decreases as the tank fills up, causing collection to be less effective
CD0673 — Back to basics, Engine room rou.answer: Because a minimum level of fluid is needed to operate the ejector which creates the vacuum

CD0673 — Back to basics, Engine room rou.question: How can signs of overheating of the running parts of auxiliary engines, e.g. generators, be checked whilst on your rounds? Select the ONE best answer.
options: By feeling the crankcase and camshaft doors using the back of the hand
By checking the lubricating oil temperatures
By checking the Fresh Water outlet temperatures
By checking that alarm panels are clear
CD0673 — Back to basics, Engine room rou.answer: By feeling the crankcase and camshaft doors using the back of the hand

CD0673 — Back to basics, Engine room rou.question: When is the best time to check the oil level in the sump of an air compressor?
options: When the compressor is stopped
When the compressor is running
When the compressor is running at full load
When the compressor is running but unloaded
CD0673 — Back to basics, Engine room rou.answer: When the compressor is stopped

CD0673 — Back to basics, Engine room rou.question: Why should you check the electric heating of the domestic hot water supply?
options: To ensure that it is not used unnecessarily when steam is available
To make sure that it is always switched on
Because it is much better to use electrical heating than steam
Just to make sure that it is switched on, and that the temperature is being controlled
CD0673 — Back to basics, Engine room rou.answer: To ensure that it is not used unnecessarily when steam is available

CD0673 — Back to basics, Engine room rou.question: Which electrical generators should be checked during your rounds of the engine room?
options: All of them
All running generators
The running generators and the first standby generator
They can all be checked using the remote monitoring systems in the engine control room only
CD0673 — Back to basics, Engine room rou.answer: All of them

CD0673 — Back to basics, Engine room rou.question: Why do the gauge glasses fitted to cylinder lub. oil tanks have a spring loaded valve at their inlet?
options: So that they are normally isolated from the oil in the tank, to reduce the risk of fire if the glass breaks
So that the valve can be wedged open whilst the tank is in use, so that the contents can be easily and continuously seen
To avoid the need for a hand-wheel
So that they are normally kept in the open position to give a continuous reading of contents
CD0673 — Back to basics, Engine room rou.answer: So that they are normally isolated from the oil in the tank, to reduce the risk of fire if the glass breaks

CD0673 — Back to basics, Engine room rou.question: When should the drive belt tension of equipment like compressors be checked by manual means?
options: Only when the compressor is switched off and isolated
When the compressor is stopped
When the compressor is running
When the compressor is running at full load
CD0673 — Back to basics, Engine room rou.answer: Only when the compressor is switched off and isolated

CD0673 — Back to basics, Engine room rou.question: Why is a water re-hardening plant needed onboard ship?
options: Because we produce drinking water by evaporation, it needs to have some hardness salts added to it to make it suitable for human consumption.
Re-hardening is necessary when water has been taken on from ashore, to ensure the correct pH for storage
Re-hardening is necessary to ensure the correct amount of residual Chlorine is maintained in drinking water
So that the water is suitable for use with detergents used for washing and in laundries
CD0673 — Back to basics, Engine room rou.answer: Because we produce drinking water by evaporation, it needs to have some hardness salts added to it to make it suitable for human consumption.

CD0673 — Back to basics, Engine room rou.question: Where should the drains from the waste oil tank go to?
options: The sludge tank
The bilge separator tank
The engine room bilges
The save-all around the waste oil tank
CD0673 — Back to basics, Engine room rou.answer: The sludge tank

CD0673 — Back to basics, Engine room rou.question: What would indicate that the sea water side of a fresh water cooler was fouled?
options: A high pressure drop and a low temperature differential on the sea water side
A low temperature differential on the fresh water side
A high temperature differential on the fresh water side.
A high temperature differential on the sea water side
CD0673 — Back to basics, Engine room rou.answer: A high pressure drop and a low temperature differential on the sea water side

CD0673 — Back to basics, Engine room rou.question: Why might a small difference in the levels indicated by the local and remote boiler water gauge glasses be acceptable?
options: Because of the list or trim of the ship
Because of blockages in the lines leading to the gauge glasses
Because we can expect the remote reading to be slightly inaccurate
Because the remote gauge glass is much more accurate
CD0673 — Back to basics, Engine room rou.answer: Because of the list or trim of the ship

CD0673 — Back to basics, Engine room rou.question: What gives us the best indication of the load on an oil fired boiler?
options: The position of the air damper
The fuel oil pressure at the burner
The steam pressure
The position of the heating valve for the boiler fuel oil supply
CD0673 — Back to basics, Engine room rou.answer: The position of the air damper

CD0673 — Back to basics, Engine room rou.question: What should you do if there are signs of water in the fuel oil settling or service tank drains? Select the ONE best answer.
options: Report this, investigate the cause, and drain the tanks more regularly
Drain the tank until the water stops
Shut off the steam heating to the affected tank
Increase the flow through the fuel oil separator
CD0673 — Back to basics, Engine room rou.answer: Report this, investigate the cause, and drain the tanks more regularly

CD0673 — Back to basics, Engine room rou.question: When we check the flame in the furnace of an oil fired boiler, what should we see?
options: A bright flame, with no signs of smoke
A bright flame, with a small amount of smoke around the outside of the flame
A bright flame, with a small amount of smoke inside the flame
As long as there is a steady flame, some signs of smoke are acceptable
CD0673 — Back to basics, Engine room rou.answer: A bright flame, with no signs of smoke

CD0673 — Back to basics, Engine room rou.question: Why should face and eye protection be used when sounding heated waste oil tanks that have their sounding pipes in the engine room?
options: Because the contents may be slightly pressurised due to the vapour generated by heating and the height of the vent to deck
Because the tank may have been pressurised by the oil pumped into it
Because the level in the tank may be higher than level of the sounding pipe
Because these types of tanks sometimes have no venting arrangements
CD0673 — Back to basics, Engine room rou.answer: Because the contents may be slightly pressurised due to the vapour generated by heating and the height of the vent to deck

CD0674 — Back to basics, Engine room rou.question: What should you do before entering any unmanned machinery space? Select the ONE best answer.
options: Inform the duty deck officer and activate any patrol alarm system that your ship has.
Let the Chief Engineer know.
Let some other member of the crew know where you are going, and how long you will be.
Leave a note in the engine control room about what time you commenced your rounds.
CD0674 — Back to basics, Engine room rou.answer: Inform the duty deck officer and activate any patrol alarm system that your ship has.

CD0674 — Back to basics, Engine room rou.question: In spaces like the steering gear, why is it important to make sure that the space heating is on?
options: To prevent the formation of condensation, which can damage electrical machinery.
So that the space is comfortable when working there.
So that the space is comfortable when walking through it on rounds etc.
To help protect the paint on bulkheads and deck-heads.
CD0674 — Back to basics, Engine room rou.answer: To prevent the formation of condensation, which can damage electrical machinery.

CD0674 — Back to basics, Engine room rou.question: When the main engine is running and you feel the pipes leading to the main engine fuel oil injectors, what should you detect?
options: There should be a strong pulse during fuel injection, but without excessive vibration.
If all the pipes are secure, you shouldn’t detect anything, since the pipes are lagged.
There will be some steady vibration, since the pipes are quite long.
The pipes are free to move and will be vibrating steadily due to hull vibration.
CD0674 — Back to basics, Engine room rou.answer: There should be a strong pulse during fuel injection, but without excessive vibration.

CD0674 — Back to basics, Engine room rou.question: What is the purpose of the Load Dependent Cylinder Liner System used by MAN Diesel ME engines?
options: To keep the jacket water temperature high enough to prevent cold corrosion at low loads.
To keep the jacket water temperature low enough to prevent corrosion at high loads.
To keep the jacket water flow low enough to prevent erosion.
To keep the jacket water flow high enough to prevent precipitation of salts on the outside of the liner walls.
CD0674 — Back to basics, Engine room rou.answer: To keep the jacket water temperature high enough to prevent cold corrosion at low loads.

CD0674 — Back to basics, Engine room rou.question: Why is there a ‘minimum’ level marked on the emergency generator fuel oil tank?
options: So that the emergency generator could provide power for long enough in an emergency.
To avoid losing suction if the ship rolls.
Because fuel is used during tests, it serves as a reminder to order more fuel.
Because a minimum head must be maintained above the generator fuel pump.
CD0674 — Back to basics, Engine room rou.answer: So that the emergency generator could provide power for long enough in an emergency.

CD0674 — Back to basics, Engine room rou.question: What is the purpose of the sight glass on the air cooler drains?
options: To check for signs of excessive condensation.
To check for signs of cooling water leakage.
To check for signs of oil contamination.
To check that there is an adequate flow.
CD0674 — Back to basics, Engine room rou.answer: To check for signs of excessive condensation.

CD0674 — Back to basics, Engine room rou.question: Why should the temperature of the main engine cylinder air start pipes be checked?
options: To detect leakage of hot exhaust from the cylinder back into the starting air system.
To detect leakage of starting air into the cylinder.
Because air gets hot when compressed.
To make sure that they are cool enough to touch when climbing up to check for leaks on top of the cylinder heads.
CD0674 — Back to basics, Engine room rou.answer: To detect leakage of hot exhaust from the cylinder back into the starting air system.

CD0674 — Back to basics, Engine room rou.question: In the Engine Control Room, what should you do if you find that any alarms have been de-activated or reposed?
options: Consult the other members of the engineering team to find out the reason for this.
Re-activate all of them.
Leave them de-activated, there must have been a good reason for this.
Use your judgement about which alarms should be re-activated.
CD0674 — Back to basics, Engine room rou.answer: Consult the other members of the engineering team to find out the reason for this.

CD0674 — Back to basics, Engine room rou.question: If any small leakage is detected on the main engine high pressure fuel oil system, what should you do?
options: Report it, so that a decision can be made about whether the system can be taken out of operation and a repair made.
Try and nip up any connections etc. that are leaking.
Stop the main engine immediately.
Set up an arrangement to collect the leakage, and monitor the situation, since these types of leaks are often intermittent.
CD0674 — Back to basics, Engine room rou.answer: Report it, so that a decision can be made about whether the system can be taken out of operation and a repair made.

CD0674 — Back to basics, Engine room rou.question: How should the steering gear be monitored for leakage of hydraulic oil? Select the ONE best answer.
options: By visual inspection of the gear itself and by monitoring levels in the operating tanks.
The low and extra low level alarms will do this for us
By visual inspection of the gear itself, and its save-all.
By recording the amount of oil used for topping up the steering gear oil tanks.
CD0674 — Back to basics, Engine room rou.answer: By visual inspection of the gear itself and by monitoring levels in the operating tanks.

CD0674 — Back to basics, Engine room rou.question: Why should the gauges at the main engine local control station be checked?
options: To make sure that they are all working, because they would be needed in an emergency.

So that we can calculate how fast the bunkers will be used up and the amount remaining on board at the next bunkering
So that we can see that the fuel is within legal limits
CD2520 — Fuel oil bunkering, Good bunker.answer: So that we can confirm the mass received and also to help us set up some types of fuel separators

CD2520 — Fuel oil bunkering, Good bunker.question: How should the sample bottles be filled from the cubitainer?
options: Shake the cubitainer to mix the contents before and between each filling, and then fill all the sample bottles one-third at a time
Do not shake the cubitainer, fill each sample bottle completely in turn and mark them as samples 1,2,3, and 4
Shake the cubitainer to mix the contents before and between each filling, and then completely fill each sample bottle one at a time
Allow the cubitainer to stand for twenty minutes before attempting to fill the sample bottles
CD2520 — Fuel oil bunkering, Good bunker.answer: Shake the cubitainer to mix the contents before and between each filling, and then fill all the sample bottles one-third at a time

CD2520 — Fuel oil bunkering, Good bunker.question: Where should bunker samples be taken?
options: At the point of custody, which is usually the ship’s bunker station
From the tanks of the bunker barge
From the ship’s tanks, once bunkering is completed
The bunker barge will hand over all of the necessary samples
CD2520 — Fuel oil bunkering, Good bunker.answer: At the point of custody, which is usually the ship’s bunker station

CD2520 — Fuel oil bunkering, Good bunker.question: At what rate should we collect the bunker sample?
options: At a constant rate that will give us enough samples, but without over-filling the cubitainer before bunkering is completed
So that we completely  fill the cubitainer as quickly as possible
It is not too important, as long as we get enough sample well before the end of bunkering
Quickly to begin with, then we can slow down the rate as bunkering continues
CD2520 — Fuel oil bunkering, Good bunker.answer: At a constant rate that will give us enough samples, but without over-filling the cubitainer before bunkering is completed

CD2524 — Safety data sheets.question: Is the following statement true or false? ^M‘All Safety Data Sheets must be stored either as a hard copy or electronically in a place that is known and accessible to everyone on board.’

False.

CD2524 — Safety data sheets.question: When should you read a Safety Data Sheet? Select the BEST answer.
options: Before using any chemical to remind ourselves of the dangers and make ourselves aware of the first aid actions.
Only when using a chemical you haven’t used before.
Only when your supervisor is watching.
Before using any flammable substances that could damage the ship.
CD2524 — Safety data sheets.answer: Before using any chemical to remind ourselves of the dangers and make ourselves aware of the first aid actions.

CD2524 — Safety data sheets.question: Section 7 of the safety data sheet is titled “Handling and Storage” What information might be found here?
options: Possible reactions of the substance with other chemicals and required segregation.
The length of time the substance can be kept on board.
The number of times the substance can be handled before it causes harm.
Transport information.
CD2524 — Safety data sheets.answer: Possible reactions of the substance with other chemicals and required segregation.

CD2524 — Safety data sheets.question: Which of the following is the BEST way to familiarise crewmembers with new or different chemicals delivered on board?

Ensure all staff read the Safety Data Sheets prior to using new or different chemicals.
Hold a briefing with ALL crewmembers about ALL chemicals used on board.
Make crewmembers read all Safety Data Sheets prior to starting work on board the vessel.
CD2524 — Safety data sheets.answer: Brief all the staff who may come into contact with the chemicals.

CD2524 — Safety data sheets.question: Which of the options BEST completes the following sentence? ^M‘If the information provided in the Safety Data Sheet is not satisfactory…’
options: ‘…do not accept the chemicals on board until the supplier can be contacted and an updated version of the Safety Data Sheet is provided.’

CD2524 — Safety data sheets.question: Section 4 of the safety data sheet is titled “First aid measures”, What information might be found here?
options: The action to take if a person is harmed by the substance.
The action to take if a fire is caused by the substance.
The action to take if there is an accidental release of the substance.
The action to take that will best aid recovery of any spilled substance.
CD2524 — Safety data sheets.answer: The action to take if a person is harmed by the substance.

CD2524 — Safety data sheets.question: Section 8 of the safety data sheet is titled “Exposure controls and personal protection”. What information might be found here?
options: The ventilation required in a space before the substance may be used there.
The action to take if there is an accidental release of the substance.
The physical and chemical properties of the substance.
Stability and reactivity .
CD2524 — Safety data sheets.answer: The ventilation required in a space before the substance may be used there.

CD2524 — Safety data sheets.question: Which of the options BEST completes the following sentence? ^M‘Safety Data Sheets must be made available to…’
options: ‘…all employees so that they can manage the risks to avoid unwanted incidents.’
‘…all officers so that they can explain the contents of the Safety Data Sheets to the ship’s crew.’
‘…the master of the vessel so that they can create the necessary procedures for officers and crewmembers.’
‘…all new employees only, as more experienced crewmembers will know the hazards involved.’
CD2524 — Safety data sheets.answer: ‘…all employees so that they can manage the risks to avoid unwanted incidents.’

CD2524 — Safety data sheets.question: Which of the options BEST completes the following sentence? ^M‘If there is an Exposure Scenario annexed to the Safety Data Sheet…’
options: ‘…the crew must ensure the relevant risk management measures are in place.’
‘…the crew must only use the chemical under supervision from senior management.’
‘…the crew must acquire a permit to work prior to using the chemical.’
‘…the crew must not use the chemical in the engine room.’
CD2524 — Safety data sheets.answer: ‘…the crew must ensure the relevant risk management measures are in place.’

CD2524 — Safety data sheets.question: Who out of the following need to know where the Safety Data Sheets are stored? Select the BEST answer.
options: All crewmembers.
Deck department staff.
Engine room staff.
Catering department staff.

CD2524 — Safety data sheets.question: What will the management team do upon receipt of a new or different Safety Data Sheet on board?
options: They will prepare chemical risk assessments, often during Safety Meetings.
They will ensure the information is correct and instruct crewmembers to use the chemicals immediately.
They will filter out non-essential Safety Data Sheets.
They will file the Safety Data Sheet and trust crew to use the chemicals safely.
CD2524 — Safety data sheets.answer: They will prepare chemical risk assessments, often during Safety Meetings.

CD2524 — Safety data sheets.question: Section 2 of the safety data sheet is titled “Hazards Identification”. What information might be found here?
options: That the substance can cause human health problems.
The name of the substance.
The composition/information on ingredients.
The action to take in case of a spill.
CD2524 — Safety data sheets.answer: That the substance can cause human health problems.

Testing of communications between fire teams and team members.

Happy.

Nervous.

Approval, Preparation, Execution and Observation.
Planning, Approval, Execution and Evaluation.
Planning, Preparation, Observation and Execution.

CD2541 — Effective fire drills.question: Which of the methods below is a tactic deployed during a drill to control the possible spread of a fire?

Opening fire dampers.

Deploying extra personnel to each hose team.

CD2543 — Effective security drills.question: Which of the options BEST completes the following sentence? ‘In respect to security drills, ISPS requires that all seafarers…’

‘…are familiar with the regulations of SOLAS.’
‘…receive instruction on security drill safety from the ship’s master.’

CD2543 — Effective security drills.question: Which of the following BEST describes the state in which it is important for personnel to practice taking effective action during security drills?

CD2543 — Effective security drills.question: Which of the methods below is a tactic deployed during a drill to control the possible panic of crew members?

CD2543 — Effective security drills.question: Which of the following helps to create more effective security drills?

CD2543 — Effective security drills.question: Which of the options below should be completed during preparations to conduct a security drill?

Because it is required by SOLAS regulations.
So that bad judgements about procedures are not made.
Team members must be guided by team leaders at all times.
CD2543 — Effective security drills.answer: Team leaders do not see everything that happens, so it is important that other viewpoints are included.

CD2543 — Effective security drills.question: Who should be involved in the debrief following every security drill?
options: Everyone involved.
Senior officers only.
Security team leaders only.

CD2543 — Effective security drills.question: Which of the options below should be considered when planning a security drill?
options: The dangers and risks inherent to the drill.
The cost of the equipment to be used or tested.

CD2543 — Effective security drills.question: Which of the options BEST completes the following sentence? ‘Plans for security drills should…’
options: ‘…be as specific as possible.’
‘…be as flexible as possible.’
