options: Check the steam traps drains to see if the traps are functioning correctly.
Check that the Cargo Officer has not opened up the heating coil valves too far.
Check the cargo heating log to see if the cargo tank temperatures are too high.
Check the heating coil steam trap drain filters to see if they are clean.
CD7055 — TOTS 1C-Operation, monitoring,.answer: Check the steam traps drains to see if the traps are functioning correctly.

CD7055 — TOTS 1C-Operation, monitoring,.question: What is the primary function of the deck seal?
options: To prevent the backflow of cargo tank gases, even when the inert gas plant is shut down.
To prevent cargo and toxic gas from entering into the engine room while the inert gas generator is in operation.
To isolate the cargo tanks from the pump room.
To provide a non-return seal on gases from the pump room to the engine room.
CD7055 — TOTS 1C-Operation, monitoring,.answer: To prevent the backflow of cargo tank gases, even when the inert gas plant is shut down.

CD7055 — TOTS 1C-Operation, monitoring,.question: You would expect a deck seal to be..
options: of wet or dry types.
mechanical type seals.
gland packings.
normal non-return valves.
CD7055 — TOTS 1C-Operation, monitoring,.answer: of wet or dry types.

CD7055 — TOTS 1C-Operation, monitoring,.question: In order to test a weld repair to a lubricating oil storage tank the tank is to be tested with compressed air to check for leakage. What is the maximum pressure that should be used?
options: 0.2 Bar
1.0 Bar
2.5 Bar
0.02 Bar
CD7055 — TOTS 1C-Operation, monitoring,.answer: 0.2 Bar

CD7055 — TOTS 1C-Operation, monitoring,.question: Plate type heat exchangers can effectively deal with..
options: low pressure fluids.
high pressure fluids.
large volumes.
vapour and gases.
CD7055 — TOTS 1C-Operation, monitoring,.answer: low pressure fluids.

CD7055 — TOTS 1C-Operation, monitoring,.question: What do you predict would be the cause, if all the auxiliary diesel engines / generators, when running in parallel operation, started shedding load and hunting?
options: It could be caused by a reduction in the flow of fuel through the main filters.
It could be caused by a defective droop setting on one of the automatic voltage regulators.
It could be caused by a loss of oil from the governor control circuit.
It could be caused by a faulty governor speed adjustment motor on one auxiliary engine.
CD7055 — TOTS 1C-Operation, monitoring,.answer: It could be caused by a reduction in the flow of fuel through the main filters.

CD7055 — TOTS 1C-Operation, monitoring,.question: In a typical tubular heat exchanger, the expansion of the tubes are accommodated by..
options: a floating header.
using pre-expanded tubes.
leaving one end of the cooler free to move axially.
choosing the right material.
CD7055 — TOTS 1C-Operation, monitoring,.answer: a floating header.

CD7055 — TOTS 1C-Operation, monitoring,.question: The easing gear fitted to boiler safety valves is there to..
options: allow the valves to be opened to release pressure in the event of a boiler problem.
allow testing to make sure that the valves are not stuck shut.
allow the valve to be eased off the seat slightly when adjusting the relief pressure.
allow testing of the valve travel during safety checks.
CD7055 — TOTS 1C-Operation, monitoring,.answer: allow the valves to be opened to release pressure in the event of a boiler problem.

CD7055 — TOTS 1C-Operation, monitoring,.question: Sewage discharge regulation can be found in the..
options: MARPOL regulations.
SOLAS regulations.
ISGOTT regulations.
Health & Safety regulations.
CD7055 — TOTS 1C-Operation, monitoring,.answer: MARPOL regulations.

CD7055 — TOTS 1C-Operation, monitoring,.question: Which of the following is most likely to make the engine run unevenly?
options: Sticky fuel pump control racks or linkage.
Unsuitable fuel.
Water in the fuel.
The fuel system not being primed.
CD7055 — TOTS 1C-Operation, monitoring,.answer: Sticky fuel pump control racks or linkage.

CD7055 — TOTS 1C-Operation, monitoring,.question: If one generator is on load and the other generator is to be taken on load (share), you need to..
options: synchronise phase and frequency of the incoming generator.
reduce the speed of both generators.
increase the speed of both generators.
start a third generator before load sharing.
CD7055 — TOTS 1C-Operation, monitoring,.answer: synchronise phase and frequency of the incoming generator.

CD7055 — TOTS 1C-Operation, monitoring,.question: For any maintenance work, the sewage system should be considered as an enclosed space.
options: True
False
CD7055 — TOTS 1C-Operation, monitoring,.answer: True
